snippet.title: FEEDSTOCK — Gameplay Trailer | Free Demo Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
▶ Play the free demo & wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5154830/FEEDSTOCK/

Your loot doesn't go in a backpack. It goes into Tally — and she grows.

FEEDSTOCK is a co-op horror game for 1–4 players. You and your crew are drones
stripping a house room by room and feeding everything you find to Tally. Feed
her too little and she eats the crew. Feed her too much and she won't fit back
through the door.

🏚 Strip the house — everything has weight, heavy things take two
🍖 Feed Tally — she grows in stages: bigger, louder, harder to get out
🔊 Noise wakes the house — every threshold brings something new
🎙 Proximity voice — you hear each other the way the house does
🔧 Back at the hangar: sell the haul, buy gear, take on a bigger quota
🚫 No weapons. Nothing in this house can be shot

Runs take 12–18 minutes. Play solo or with up to four friends.
23 languages.

The demo is out now. We'll be at Steam Next Fest, October 19–26.
Releasing October 2026.

Developer: Ahaha studio

#FEEDSTOCK #coophorror #indiehorror
